originalTitle: Carney claps back at Lutnick, says Canada will resume trade talks 'when the Americans are ready'
summary: Canada has retaliated against President Donald Trump's 50% tariffs with "dollar for dollar" duties on U.S. goods, which are set to take effect next week.
content:
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on Thursday returned fire after Trump administration Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick claimed Ottawa tanked trade talks with the U.S. for political purposes.

"I don't think, with all respect, appointed, unelected Cabinet members in the United States are experts on Canadian politics," Carney said during a news conference in Thunder Bay in Northwestern Ontario.

"We are always going to stand up for what's in the best interest of Canada," Carney said, after accusing the U.S. of making different claims about their red lines for a trade deal now that negotiations have been scrapped.

But the prime minister maintained that a deal benefiting both Canada and the U.S. is possible. "We're ready to sit down and strike that deal when the Americans are ready," he said.

President Donald Trump later Thursday morning appeared less open to rekindling the U.S. and Canada's chilly relations, however.

"It is very good for Canadian Politicians like Prime Minister Carney to make President Donald J. Trump 'the enemy,' until their Economy collapses," Trump wrote in a Truth Social post . "Then it will prove to be very bad for Politics — Worse than anything that has ever happened to a Canadian Politician. Just watch!"

Carney was responding to Lutnick's claim on CNBC's " Squawk Box " a day earlier that the Canadians "blew up" a nearly complete trade deal with the U.S. "for political reasons only."

Canada treated Trump "disrespectfully," but they will change their tune after mid-October "because their elections will be behind them," Lutnick asserted.

Canada has upcoming special elections , or by-elections, in a handful of ridings, or parliamentary districts.

Read more CNBC politics and policy coverage

Negotiators walked away from trade talks last month after failing to clinch a deal before Trump's Aug. 22 deadline for new 50% tariffs on some $20 billion worth of Canadian imports.

Canada has retaliated with "dollar for dollar" tariffs on U.S. goods, which are set to take effect next week.

Each side has accused the other of making unreasonable last-minute demands. Lutnick said Wednesday that Canada tried to add tariff relief on medium- and heavy-duty trucks just hours before Trump's tariff deadline. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer has previously denied Carney's claim that Canadian French-language requirements were a sticking point in the trade talks.

Carney in Thursday's remarks pushed back. "There are a few issues that the United States was arguing right up to the last hour. Red lines weren't going to change ... 'our way or the highway, take it or leave it,' you know, attitude."

"All of a sudden they don't care about Canadian language or culture and those elements," Carney said, adding, "Good. We welcome that. We care about those issues."

On the dispute over trucks, Carney accused the U.S. of backtracking on its demands.

"They're like, 'Of course, we weren't going to keep them out.' Well, they were going to keep them out," he said. "Some of what they're saying now is different than what they were drawing the line on."
chineseTitle: 卡尼回击卢特尼克称，“当美国人准备好时”加拿大将恢复贸易谈判
chineseSummary: 加拿大对美国商品征收“一元对一元”关税，以报复唐纳德·特朗普总统征收 50% 的关税，该关税将于下周生效。
chineseContent:
加拿大总理马克·卡尼周四对特朗普政府商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克声称渥太华出于政治目的破坏与美国的贸易谈判进行了反击。

卡尼在安大略省西北部桑德贝举行的新闻发布会上表示：“恕我直言，我不认为美国任命的非选举内阁成员是加拿大政治专家。”

卡尼表示：“我们将始终坚持维护加拿大的最大利益。”他指责美国在谈判已被取消后对其贸易协议的红线提出了不同的主张。

但总理坚称，达成一项对加拿大和美国都有利的协议是可能的。他说：“当美国人准备好时，我们准备坐下来达成这项协议。”

然而，周四上午晚些时候，唐纳德·特朗普总统似乎不太愿意重新点燃美国和加拿大的冷淡关系。

“对于像卡尼总理这样的加拿大政客来说，让唐纳德·J·特朗普总统成为‘敌人’，直到他们的经济崩溃，这是非常好的，”特朗普在《真相社会》的帖子中写道。 “那么这对政治来说将是非常糟糕的——比加拿大政治家所经历过的任何事情都更糟糕。就看吧！”

一天前，卡尼在 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”节目中回应了卢特尼克的说法，即加拿大人“仅出于政治原因”“毁掉了”与美国几乎完整的贸易协议。

加拿大对特朗普“不尊重”，但他们将在十月中旬之后改变态度，“因为他们的选举将在他们身后”，卢特尼克断言。

加拿大即将在少数选区或议会选区举行特别选举或补选。

阅读更多 CNBC 政治和政策报道

谈判代表上个月退出了贸易谈判，因为未能在特朗普设定的8月22日最后期限前达成协议，对价值约200亿美元的加拿大进口产品征收新的50%关税。

加拿大对美国商品征收“一美元对一美元”的关税作为报复，该关税将于下周生效。

双方都指责对方在最后一刻提出了无理要求。卢特尼克周三表示，就在特朗普关税截止日期前几个小时，加拿大试图对中型和重型卡车增加关税减免。美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔此前否认了卡尼的说法，即加拿大的法语要求是贸易谈判的一个症结所在。

卡尼在周四的言论中进行了反驳。 “直到最后一个小时，美国还在争论一些问题。红线不会改变……‘我们的道路或高速公路，接受或离开’，你知道，态度。”

卡尼说：“突然之间，他们不再关心加拿大的语言或文化以及这些元素。”他补充道，“很好。我们对此表示欢迎。我们关心这些问题。”

在卡车争端上，卡尼指责美国对自己的要求出尔反尔。

“他们会说，‘当然，我们不会把他们拒之门外。’好吧，他们会把他们拒之门外，”他说。 “他们现在所说的一些内容与他们所划定的界限不同。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
